## Major Mathematical & Academic Milestones
- **ONMIPA-PT Nasional:** Muhammad Faran Aiki won the **Silver Medal** at the National level of ONMIPA-PT in Mathematics during his 2nd semester. This is a monumental achievement for an Information Systems and Technology (STI) student competing directly against Pure Mathematics majors.
- **Paragon Scholarship:** Awarded the prestigious Paragon Scholarship Program Excellence in his 3rd semester, cementing his outstanding academic and professional trajectory.
